svg.title: Cone: lateral surface area
svg.desc: A Pac-Man-shaped 270-degree sector and its matching broad cone, with a leftward cut-and-spread-flat arrow. The sector angle is 2 pi r/s radians. The full generator has length s and the base radius is r. A blue arrow identifies the generator midpoint. The blue midpoint path has radius r/2 on the cone and length pi r. The outer sector arc has length 2 pi r. The lateral area is pi r s; the base is excluded.
